title: Old Fresno Water Tower
scope: The extant Old Fresno Water Tower exterior, including the Romanesque shaft, circular balcony, projecting stair turret and red tiled cap.
limitations: The source does not provide measured sizes for openings, trim, the exact position of all small openings, or the balcony ironwork. Those dimensions are approximate.
The structure covers the tower exterior. The separate plaza facilities and interior tank mechanism are outside the model scope.
